summary.text: Eduardo Guzman is the Democratic candidate for Arkansas State Senate District 27 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Justin Boyd (R).
According to Ballotpedia, he is an educator.

paragraphs.text: Eduardo Guzman earned a bachelor's degree from Houston Baptist University in 2012, along with graduate degrees from the University of Arkansas, Fayetteville, and the University of Arkansas, Little Rock, according to Ballotpedia.
His career experience includes working as an educator.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Guzman described himself as a former business owner and current University of Arkansas at Fort Smith educator who is running to be the next state senator from Fort Smith.
He said his campaign would focus on utility rate transparency, workforce apprenticeships and vocational partnerships, protecting Medicaid expansion, and keeping public funds in public classrooms.
